name: Fuerza Regida / Street Mob Records
brand_voice: Authentic Regional Mexican / Musica Mexicana & LA/IE bilingual street culture. Raw, unpolished, confident, and relatable (desamor, toxic-relationship POVs, trokiando/car edits, nightlife/antros, hustle/flex, corridos belicos). Zero corporate copy or translated-AI slang.

production_constraints.visual_sources: 100% faceless & scalable: existing online viral clips (DBZ/SpongeBob/Shrek/anime, movies, sports highlights, trokiando/car footage, comedy clips), TikTok/IG photo carousels & WhatsApp/iMessage screenshots, AI-generated/animated loops (GTA/anime/3D LA-IE street scenes), or recut existing Fuerza Regida / Street Mob concert & MV footage.
